name: 1.º Aniversário FUJIFILM
description: Celebrate the first anniversary of the FUJIFILM House of Photography with a photowalk led by Duarte Silva and the opening of a participatory exhibition.
longDescription:
The FUJIFILM House of Photography celebrates its first year in Porto with a public event. This occasion includes a guided photowalk led by photographer Duarte Silva, offering participants an opportunity to explore the city through a photographic lens. The celebration also marks the inauguration of a new exhibition, which features contributions from the public.

Visitors can expect an afternoon focused on photography and community engagement. The event is scheduled for approximately two hours, beginning in the afternoon. The photowalk will likely involve walking through parts of the city centre, while the exhibition will be housed within the FUJIFILM House of Photography itself, a dedicated space for photographic arts.

Attendance is free of charge. The FUJIFILM House of Photography is located near the Trindade metro station, approximately a five-minute walk. Further details regarding the photowalk route and exhibition content will be available at the venue.
